fusions.name: Stridulant Shriek
fusions.desc: A shriek through a cone 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 resonating damage to everything in it, stuns them for 1 second and leaves them [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Thirst at Dusk
fusions.desc: Sends part of the swarm into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Roosting Pall
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later. The veil breaks when you attack.

fusions.name: Sated on the Wing
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
